title: Adapter Server & Schema Introspection
description:
## Overview
Add comprehensive server introspection and schema metadata capabilities to all database adapters to support UI features and library functionality.

## Scope
**In Scope:**
- Server version and configuration details
- Database/schema enumeration with metadata (size, owner, created date)
- Enhanced table/collection schema introspection
- Column metadata: data types, constraints, defaults, comments
- Index information (name, columns, type, uniqueness)
- Primary/foreign key relationships
- View metadata
- Stored procedure/function enumeration

**Out of Scope:**
- Performance metrics and monitoring
- Query execution plans
- Real-time statistics
- Backup/restore metadata

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All adapters can retrieve server version and configuration
- [ ] Database/schema listing includes metadata (size, creation date, owner)
- [ ] Table schema includes indexes, constraints, relationships
- [ ] Column info includes full type details, nullability, defaults, comments
- [ ] Foreign key relationships are retrievable
- [ ] View definitions accessible
- [ ] Stored procedures/functions enumerable
close_reason: All 6 database adapters now have comprehensive introspection capabilities. PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, MSSQL, and Oracle all implement 8 introspection methods with full test coverage.

Region Trait Specification:

1. Region trait - polymorphic interface for dockable areas
2. LeftPanelRegion - multi-component tabbed region with resize/visibility
3. MainPanelRegion - multi-component tabbed region (always visible)

Region Trait Signature:
```rust
pub trait Region {
    fn id(&self) -> RegionId;
    fn active_component(&self) -> Option<ComponentId>;
    fn set_active_component(&mut self, component_id: ComponentId);
    fn view<'a, Message: 'a + Clone>(

        theme: ThemeColors,
        on_action: impl Fn(ComponentAction) -> Message + 'a,
    ) -> Element<'a, Message>;
}
```

- Trait for polymorphic region behavior (vs enum)
- Active tab state stored in region (UI state, not data state)
- Render-time queries to ViewRegistry (dynamic updates)
- Generic view() method for message composition
- Helper function for shared tab rendering logic
- Auto-switch active tab when toggling off active view
- Explicit initialization of active tabs in DatabaseIDE::new()

- Visibility toggle support
- Tabbed multi-component rendering
- Query enabled_views(LeftPanel) from ViewRegistry

- Always visible (no toggle)

- Regions stored as concrete structs in DatabaseIDE

- Query enabled_views() for region

- Click handler sends SelectTab message

Content Rendering Pattern:
- Find active component in enabled views
- Call view.component().view(theme, on_action)
- Delegate rendering to component's view() method
- Fallback to "No component selected" if none active

2. **docs/configuration/settings-schema.md** (600+ lines)

## Schema Sections

### [logging] - rusty-logging Integration
- filter: Global log level (info)
- console_filter: Console-specific override (optional)
- console_format: pretty | compact
- console_writer: stdout | stderr
- console_enabled: bool
- file_filter: File-specific override (optional)
- file_enabled: bool
- file_format: text | json
- file_directory: ~/.rusty-app/logs
- file_prefix: rusty-app
- rotation_policy: daily | hourly | minutely | never

### [[connections]] - Database Connections Array
- id: Unique identifier
- name: Display name
- db_type: postgres | mysql | sqlite | mongodb | sqlserver | oracle
- host: Server hostname (optional for SQLite)
- port: Server port (uses defaults)
- database: Database name or file path
- username: Auth username (optional)
- use_ssl: Enable SSL/TLS (default false)
- parameters: Additional connection params (table)

### [ui_preferences] - UI Settings
- theme: dark | light
- panel_width: 200-600 pixels
- show_left_panel: bool
- active_component: server_list | table_list | properties
- window_width, window_height: Window dimensions

### For rusty-app-7hx (SettingsManager implementation):
- Complete TOML schema ready for parsing
- All field types and defaults documented
- Validation rules specified
- Example file demonstrates all features

### For rusty-app-0l5.3 (Connection migration):

- Compatible with existing ConnectionConfig struct
- Migration path documented (connections.toml -> settings.toml)

## Key Design Decisions

1. **TOML Format**: Human-readable, widely supported, good for config files
2. **Location**: ~/.rusty-app/settings.toml (user-specific, standard location)
3. **Sections**: Logical grouping (logging, connections, ui_preferences)
